title: School maths skill names in 7 languages, in each country's curriculum terminology
description: Names of 473 school mathematics skills (domains, topics, skills) in English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Dutch, in the curriculum and textbook terminology of each country rather than a literal translation. English and Polish names are human-written; the other five are machine translations reviewed against the national curriculum documents. Skill identifiers match the Imaginesis curriculum crosswalk and prerequisite graph. Prepared by Imaginesis (https://imaginesis.com), a maths worksheet generator.
